data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business (2016: GBP 3,031k, predominately in respect of Property and Accident and Health businesses).

named_events.loss_description: The 2017 claims ratio has been adversely impacted by the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior year reserves increased (strengthened) by approximately GBP 11.7m on a gross basis in 2017 (c. +15.1% of opening gross reserves). The managing agent narrative refers to a net positive run-off (a GBP 3.714m favourable run-off) predominately in Accident & Health (and previously Property) but the gross claims development triangle shows a net gross deterioration driven by older underwriting years (notably 2013 and 2015 movements) partially offset by releases in the oldest years. The syndicate also notes that current-year results were adversely affected by storm and earthquake losses in Q3 2017.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was calculated from the GROSS claims development triangle (page 37). The managing agent narrative on page 32 reports a net favourable run-off of GBP 3,714k (net of reinsurance) which conflicts with the gross triangle-derived result (gross strengthening of ~GBP 11.7m). The prior_year_development_gbp_m above is the gross figure derived from the triangle per the extraction rules; the narrative net figure is reported verbatim in exact_reserve_text. Some LOB-level movements are described qualitatively only (hence null amounts). Triangle is reported in original units (thousands) in _claims_triangle.
